data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe** for most businesses, with **PayPal** offered as an additional payment option.

However, the best choice depends on your e-commerce platform, transaction volume and the types of customers you sell to.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK cards: approximately 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly fee on standard pay-as-you-go pricing
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and major cards
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Widely recognised by online shoppers
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance or cards
- Easy to integrate
- Transaction fees are generally higher.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**
**Best for online and physical stores**

- Around 1.4% + 25p for standard UK online card payments
- Online store functionality
- Integrates with physical card readers
- Good for businesses selling both online and in person.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Shopify Payments**
**Best for Shopify stores**

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- Simplifies checkout and refunds
- No additional third-party transaction fee
- Processing fees depend on your Shopify plan.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**
**Best for European customers**

- Competitive UK and European card rates
- Multiple European payment methods
- Good e-commerce integrations
- Useful for stores selling internationally.

Website: [Mollie](https://www.mollie.com/)

These are indicative UK pricing comparisons; actual fees depend on card type, country and payment method. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateway/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/best-startup-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/uk/blog/ecommerce-payment-gateway?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online shop | Stripe |
| Selling on Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling on WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Selling across Europe | Mollie |
| Want customers to have more payment choices | Stripe + PayPal |
